column1: # ESP32-C5 Partition Table (CSV) - tuned and documented.
# - Empty offsets: ESP-IDF computes them while preserving alignment (data: 4 KB; app: 64 KB).
# - Recommended flash: >= 8 MB. Total without bootloader/ptable is about 7.8 MB (see below).
# - Dual OTA: each slot is 3712K (= 58 x 64 KB) to avoid padding.
# Zigbee factory data (aligned to a 4 KB sector).
# OTA app #0 (size is a multiple of 64 KB to avoid padding).
